title: Verify session tokens
brief: Add verify(secret, token, now) for the session tokens sign() issues. Scenarios, each with a test: a valid token returns its user; a tampered token is rejected; an EXPIRED token (now at or past expires_at) is rejected.
tasks: Test each of the three scenarios

expected.why: The expired-token scenario has no test: deleting the `int(expires_at) <= now` check leaves every test green, and a token would then live forever.
